ns2:section.sectionText: Enrollment restricted to Psychology seniors and juniors through April 22. Seniors have priority through April 12. Juniors may begin registering for this lab course on April 13. Non-Psychology juniors and seniors will be able to enroll after April 22. This section focuses on human learning and memory. Students will participate in 3-4 experiments designed by the instructors and work in pairs during the final portion of the course to develop, implement, and report an experiment of their own conceptualization.
